title: Short-Sale Statement Foreclosure Charge Schedule
content:
Short-sale statement foreclosure charge schedule — Payoff and Loan Satisfaction

| Days from the referral date to the statement date | Status referred to foreclosure | Any other status |
|---|---|---|
| 30 or more | USD 2525.00 | nothing |
| fewer than 30, or no referral date | USD 875.00 | nothing |

**Clause.** On the payoff case of an Approved Short Sale Payoff requested by the borrower of record, the short-sale statement foreclosure charge enters the short-sale statement balance. The short-sale statement foreclosure charge is USD 2525.00, the full foreclosure charges, when the maturity case's status is referred to foreclosure and its referral date is at least 30 calendar days before the statement date; it is USD 875.00, the initial foreclosure charges, when its status is referred to foreclosure and it was referred fewer days before, a case with no referral date counting as referred 0 days before; a case in any other status carries nothing (0.00). Status and referral date are read from the loan's maturity case under the Maturity and Due-and-Payable Cases product.

**Boundary cases.**

| Maturity case on the statement date | Short-sale statement foreclosure charge |
|---|---|
| Referred to foreclosure, referral date 30 or more days before | USD 2525.00 |
| Referred to foreclosure, referral date 29 days before | USD 875.00 |
| Referred to foreclosure on the statement date itself (0 days) | USD 875.00 |
| Referred to foreclosure, no referral date recorded | USD 875.00 |
| Due and payable, or in its extension period | nothing |
